basic_details.job_title: CIHTS Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 19 Junior Office Assistant, Pharmacist and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Deputy Medical Superintendent (Sowa-Rigpa), Medical Officer (Sowa-Rigpa), Nursing Superintendent / Matron (Sowa-Rigpa) and 14 more
basic_details.short_information: Central Institute of Higher Tibetan Studies (CIHTS), Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, has invited applications for 19 posts in 17 roles under Advt No. CIHTS/Admn./Rectt./02/2026. The posts include Deputy Medical Superintendent (Sowa-Rigpa), Medical Officer (Sowa-Rigpa), Nursing Superintendent / Matron (Sowa-Rigpa), Assistant Librarian (Sowa-Rigpa) and 13 more. The online application is open from 28 November 2026 to 28 December 2026.

age_limit.age_details: Varies by post - see the table below

qualification.education_qualification: Diploma, Graduate, Ph.D, Master's degree, 12th, B.Sc, depending on the post

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 18,000 to Rs. 1,77,500, depending on the post

exam_pattern.details: Syllabus, modalities and evaluation procedure as approved by the Vice-Chancellor (RR 5.15)

how_to_apply: Apply online only through the recruitment portal https://cihtsnt.samarth.edu.in between 28-11-2026 (10 AM) and 28-12-2026 (11:59 PM).
Register with a valid e-mail ID and mobile number that stay active until the process ends.
Upload the listed documents in legible scanned form and pay ₹1,000/- online where applicable.
Submit a separate application, with fee, for each post (Post Code).

Send the printed application with self-attested copies of all enclosures by Registered Post/Speed Post to the Registrar, Central Institute of Higher Tibetan Studies, Sarnath, Varanasi – 221007 (U.P.).
Superscribe the envelope with the Advertisement No., Post Code, Name of the Post applied for and Category; hard copy must be received by 07-01-2027.
important_instructions: Separate application with fee for each post; only one application per post accepted No change accepted after the application is submitted Change of address/phone/e-mail to be sent to [email protected] Number of vacancies is indicative and may vary Corrigendum or addendum will be published only on the Institute's website/portal Candidates appear for test/interview at their own expense

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for CIHTS Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Age relaxation, Dresser (Sowa-Rigpa): Departmental candidates (Group C) Up to 40 years (45 years for SC/ST). Other conditions: Typing speed of 35 w.p.m. in English or 30 w.p.m. in Hindi, or bilingual, on a computer for the three office posts Proficiency in the Bhoti (Tibetan) language is essential for Junior Office Assistant (Account) (Sowa-Rigpa) Medical and nursing posts need registration with the council named for each post Certificates in neither English nor Hindi need a self-attested English or Hindi translation In-service candidates must apply through proper channel and submit the employer's No Objection Certificate Desirable: Knowledge of the Bhoti language (several Sowa-Rigpa posts) Proficiency in or knowledge of computer applications (most posts) Postgraduate degree in Sowa-Rigpa/Menrampa (Deputy Medical Superintendent, Medical Officer) Diploma/Degree in Hospital Administration (Nursing Superintendent / Matron) Knowledge of ancient scripts (Research Assistant RBTR, Transcribe Newari)

rows.qualification: Menpa Kachupa/BTMS, BSMS (Sowa-Rigpa)/BSRMS from a recognised University/Institution/College, with a minimum of 2 years' clinical experience; registered with the National or State ASUS Commission or Council.
Menpa Kachupa/BTMS, BSMS (Sowa-Rigpa)/BSRMS degree from a recognised University/Institution; Registered with NCISM or the State Council
Graduate in Nursing or Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery, with 3 years' experience; registered as a Nurse and Midwife with the State Nursing Council/Indian Nursing Council.

Master's Degree in Library Science, Information Science or Documentation Science or an equivalent professional degree with at least 55% marks, OR Master's Degree in Tibetan Buddhist Studies with Bachelor's Degree in Library Science/Information Science/Documentation with at least 55% marks; Consistently good academic record, with knowledge of computerisation of a library; A Ph.D. degree in Tibetan Buddhist Studies
Master's Degree with at least 55% marks in Bhot Bauddha Darshan/Tibetan Buddhist Philosophy or Sanskrit Bauddha Darshan; erudition in Tibetan and Sanskrit with knowledge of Hindi or English.
Master's Degree with 55% marks in Bhot Bauddha Darshan/Tibetan Buddhist Philosophy or Sanskrit Bauddha Darshan; erudition in Tibetan and Sanskrit language with knowledge of Hindi and English.
Master's Degree with 55% marks in Bhot Bauddha Darshan/Tibetan Buddhist Philosophy or Sanskrit Bauddha Darshan; erudition in Tibetan and Sanskrit language with knowledge of Hindi or English.
Postgraduate Degree with 55% marks in Bauddha Darshan/Bhot Bauddha Darshan/Tibetan Buddhist Philosophy; erudition in Sanskrit/Bhoti.
Postgraduate Degree with 55% marks in Bhot Bauddha Darshan/Tibetan Buddhist Philosophy; erudition in Bhoti.
Postgraduate Degree with 55% marks in Bauddha Darshan/Bhot Bauddha Darshan; erudition in Sanskrit.
Diploma in Pharmacy or Dhuerawa, or 10+2 with orientation in dispensing Sowa-Rigpa medicines.
Recognised Degree or Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technician.

Bachelor's Degree in Commerce, Bhoti (Tibetan) proficiency, 2 years' experience as LDC/Junior Clerk in Pay Level-2 or equivalent, typing 35 w.p.m. English or 30 w.p.m. Hindi on computer, computer operation, noting and drafting; OR Master's Degree in Commerce with Bhoti proficiency, the same typing speed and computer skills.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CIHTS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 28 December 2026. Applications opened on 28 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CIHTS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 19 vacancies: 1 Deputy Medical Superintendent (Sowa-Rigpa), 2 Medical Officer (Sowa-Rigpa), 1 Nursing Superintendent / Matron (Sowa-Rigpa), 1 Assistant Librarian (Sowa-Rigpa), 2 Research Assistant (Translation), 1 Research Assistant (Dictionary) and 11 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CIHTS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 28 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: UR/OBC/EWS: ₹1,000. Women and SC/ST/PwBD: Exempt.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Deputy Medical Superintendent (Sowa-Rigpa): maximum 40 years; Medical Officer (Sowa-Rigpa): maximum 40 years; Nursing Superintendent / Matron (Sowa-Rigpa): maximum 40 years; Assistant Librarian (Sowa-Rigpa): maximum 40 years; Research Assistant (Translation): maximum 40 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Level-10 (₹56,100 – 1,77,500) for Deputy Medical Superintendent (Sowa-Rigpa), Level-10 (₹56,100 – 1,77,500) for Medical Officer (Sowa-Rigpa), Level-10 (₹56,100 – 1,77,500) for Nursing Superintendent / Matron (Sowa-Rigpa), Level-10 (₹56,100 – 1,77,500) for Assistant Librarian (Sowa-Rigpa), Level-7 (₹44,900 – 1,42,400) for Research Assistant (Translation).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Diploma, Graduate, Ph.D, Master's degree, 12th, B.Sc, depending on the post. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Typing speed of 35 w.p.m. in English or 30 w.p.m. in Hindi, or bilingual, on a computer for the three office posts. Proficiency in the Bhoti (Tibetan) language is essential for Junior Office Assistant (Account) (Sowa-Rigpa). Medical and nursing posts need registration with the council named for each post. Certificates in neither English nor Hindi need a self-attested English or Hindi translation.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates without the essential qualifications and experience on the crucial date (last date of online application). Persons with less than forty per cent disability will not be considered against posts reserved for PwBD. Canvassing in any form shall disqualify the candidate.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Written test and/or skill/typing test and/or interview, as prescribed for the post in the RR. Interview call in the ratio of 10:1 on merit in the written and/or skill test. Verification of original documents. Selection through written test and/or skill/typing test and/or interview as prescribed for the post in the RR.
